sections.heading: Why visit Chikmagalur
paragraphs: Chikmagalur (Karnataka) is known for its hills, coffee and trek experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is September to March.
